input.quote: Corio Customer Application Management Revenue: Corio to pay Commerce One [*] of all Application Management Revenue from Corio Customers for use of Commerce One Software or MarketSite.net Service Access subject to the following limitations.
input.rationale: Exhibit B sets fixed pricing and revenue-share percentages with no most-favoured-nation or best-terms mechanic in either direction, and nothing obliges us to extend Commerce One terms no less favourable than those we give third parties or to match third-party offers. No redline required.
